Branch decisions
+-- fork(viewId, name)
|   `-- child opens from parent's saved final
+-- alternatives(viewId, names)
|   +-- 1-10 unique names; one pinned final
|   `-- grouped children; canvas stays put

|   +-- save it; archive other group members
|   `-- include descendants of archived siblings
`-- discard(viewId)
